body.name: explicit unequal-information annotation-frontier rate
body.construction:
For \(N=n+m\), set
\[
r_\epsilon(n,m,d):=\min\!\left\{1,\frac1n+
 \left(\frac{d}{N\log(en)}\right)^2\right\}.
\]
The subscript records the model's fixed overlap constant; the displayed numerical function itself does not depend on \(\epsilon\).
